jobs.description:
Antora Energy delivers affordable, reliable energy to industry, data centers, and the grid. Our thermal batteries turn low-cost electricity into always-on heat and power, without supply-constrained critical minerals or multi-year construction timelines.

We are growing our company with people who put team and mission first, value connection through laughter and joy, and work with humility and openness. We are committed to building a diverse, passionate, and creative team dedicated to a future powered by abundant, clean, low-cost energy.

About The Role

Antora Energy is looking for a full-stack product engineer to build the software products that power our business - from external customer experiences to internal tools used by teams across Business Development, Operations, and R&D.

In this role, you’ll help shape product vision, design the underlying data models, and connect AI systems with the business logic that makes them useful. You’ll own products end to end, working directly with users to understand their workflows, translate ambiguous needs into practical solutions, and ship software that performs reliably in production.

You’ll also help build Antora’s long-term software capabilities. That means creating systems, standards, and guardrails that allow partner teams to safely modify existing tools and build new ones within our ecosystem - without engineering becoming a bottleneck.

This is a highly autonomous role with direct influence over how software is designed and built at Antora. We’re looking for deep expertise in one or more core areas - such as software engineering, data modeling, AI integration, or product development - along with the curiosity and practical judgment to work across the full stack.

What You'll Do
Build Full-Stack Products

Design, build, deploy, and maintain internal and external software products across the frontend, backend, data, and AI layers. Own the complete product lifecycle, including architecture, observability, reliability, and ongoing maintenance.


Enable Self-Service

Put workflow creation directly into users’ hands. Build systems that allow analysts, operators, and other domain experts to adapt their own tools without filing a ticket and waiting for engineering support.


Co-Create with Users

Work alongside the people doing the work. Learn their processes, build solutions with them, and give them the tools and confidence to continue improving those solutions independently.

When users contribute their own code or workflows, you’ll make those contributions safe to run, easy to review, and straightforward to maintain.

Establish a Unified Data Model

Design the data foundation that powers Antora’s products. Connect business systems, operational data, and plant telemetry through tested transformation pipelines and a governed semantic layer.

You’ll help ensure that critical concepts—such as revenue, availability, and delivered steam—have consistent definitions across dashboards, AI assistants, applications, and autonomous agents.

Design for Data Security

Build and enforce strong access controls for sensitive, proprietary, and counterparty-restricted data. Ensure every product, workflow, and AI interface consistently respects authorization boundaries.

At Antora, an AI system that answers an unauthorized question is not a clever feature—it is a business risk.

Build Proactive AI Guardrails

Make evaluation a core part of product development rather than a final checkpoint. Create systems that identify task failures, tool-calling errors, grounding gaps, security issues, and regressions before they reach users.

Where AI systems influence financial decisions, operational dispatch, or customer commitments, you’ll build safeguards that are rigorous, reliable, and easy for teams to use.

Set Engineering Standards

Help define architectural patterns, development practices, and technical guardrails across Antora’s software ecosystem. Distinguish between controls that prevent real failures and processes that create unnecessary friction.

What We're Looking For
  • Strong product judgment. You can turn vague, shifting requests into a clear product direction, write an effective specification, and ship a solution. You know how to challenge a feature request that misses the underlying problem while maintaining stakeholder trust.
  • Production software engineering experience. You have strong Python and TypeScript skills and are comfortable working across frontend and backend systems. You have owned applications end to end, including deployment, observability, reliability, and maintenance.
  • Experience shipping AI-powered products. You have built and deployed LLM-powered systems used by real users - and have learned from the unexpected ways those systems failed in production.
  • Strong data fundamentals. You are comfortable with SQL, warehouse modeling, and tools such as dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks. You have shipped data changes through CI and think proactively about data quality, freshness, lineage, and testing.
  • A collaborative approach to building. You have a track record of building with non-engineers, not simply building for them. You’re comfortable pairing, teaching, reviewing someone’s first pull request, and helping users become increasingly self-sufficient.
  • Clear cross-functional communication. You can connect product, data, AI, and software engineering considerations - and communicate technical decisions in a way that allows everyone in the room to contribute.
  • Practical risk judgment. You can distinguish between controls that prevent meaningful failures and ceremony that slows teams down. You know where users can safely make changes independently and where review or stronger governance is required.
  • A growth mindset. We do not expect one person to be an expert in every discipline. We value deep expertise, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and a willingness to learn across the stack.
Bonus Qualifications
  • Experience building or maintaining semantic layers using tools such as dbt or Cube
  • Familiarity with ClickHouse, time-series data, or IoT systems
  • Experience with agent protocols such as MCP or with plugin and tool APIs
  • Background in energy, industrial technology, or manufacturing
  • Experience managing AI model usage, performance, and cost governance

Work Location: Remote / US based

Salary Range: $183-240k USD

Salary Basis:

Please note that the salary range listed above reflects Antora Energy's estimated pay for this position. The actual salary offered will be within the posted range and determined based on several factors including but not limited to a candidate's experiences, credentials and expertise, as they pertain to the position's requirements.

In addition to a competitive base salary, Antora Energy’s Total Rewards program includes equity compensation in the form of stock options, a premium health benefits package with life and disability insurance, a 401K plan with employer contributions, flexible spending accounts, and an industry leading paid-time-off policy that features flexible and inclusive holiday observance, as well as paid volunteer time off.

Flowers Foods, Inc. (NYSE:FLO) is not just about baking; it's about crafting moments of joy with every delicious bite. From the wholesome goodness of Nature's Own and Wonder to the bold and artisanal flavors of Dave's Killer Bread, the rustic goodness of Canyon Bakehouse, and the sweet delights of Tastykake, each product is a celebration of taste and quality. Beyond the oven, Flowers Foods fosters a culture that values and reflects Honesty & Integrity, Respect & Inclusion, Sustainability, Passion, and Humility. With a commitment to innovation and a recipe for success, Flowers Foods is more than a bakery – it's a delightful journey into the heart of flavor and community.

  • Comprehensive health and medical benefits
  • 401(k) Retirement savings plan

jobs.description:
About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate—we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

Role

We are looking for a Senior IT Security Operations Engineer, Corporate Infrastructure to join our team. This is a Remote within the United States (with a hybrid preference for San Jose, CA) role, reporting to the Director - Zscaler on Zscaler in the Corporate Infrastructure department. As the operational backbone of the security team, you will keep policies tuned, alerts triaged, and platforms healthy while supporting Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX), AI Security, and Cloud Security (CSPM/DSPM) to mature our DevSecOps model.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Provide day-to-day operational support, configuration, policy tuning, and platform health monitoring for ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, AI Security, and Cloud Security
  • Configure and maintain zero trust policies covering user-to-application access, posture checking, SSL/TLS inspection, content filtering, and access control
  • Deploy and tune Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) policies, collaborating with environment owners on remediation
  • Utilize ZDX to monitor application and user experience issues, correlating findings with network and security telemetry to identify root causes
  • Support DLP policy tuning, alert triage, SOP documentation, and on-call incident response while helping automate repetitive workflows

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You are a problem-solver. You seek out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action, taking full accountability for security platform health with high integrity.
  • You are driven by innovation. You have a deep curiosity for how things work and leverage automation and AI tools to continuously improve security workflows.
  • You champion simplicity. You are skilled at distilling complex cloud, network, and security architectures into clear, simple, and actionable operational procedures.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You build strong cross-functional partnerships across environment owners, support teams, and product groups to drive security outcomes.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • U.S. Citizenship required due to specific customer security requirements
  • 5+ years of experience in IT security operations, network security, or a related technical domain
  • Hands-on experience administering Zscaler ZIA and/or ZPA security platforms
  • Working knowledge of zero trust concepts, including identity verification, role-based access control, network segmentation, and posture checking
  • Practical understanding of cloud architecture (AWS, Azure, GCP), OS fundamentals (Windows, macOS, Linux), networking concepts, and authentication protocols

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Hands-on configuration experience with SSL/TLS inspection, DLP, SIEM integration, log streaming (NSS), and EDR platforms such as CrowdStrike Falcon
  • Strong network troubleshooting skills utilizing tools like tcpdump, Wireshark, ping, and traceroute/MTR alongside familiarity with DevSecOps workflows
  • Active technical certifications such as Zscaler ZCCA/ZCCP, CrowdStrike CCFA/CCFR, Security+, or CISSP

Zscaler’s salary ranges are benchmarked and are determined by role and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations and could be higher or lower based on a multitude of factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

The base salary range listed for this full-time position excludes commission/ bonus/ equity (if applicable) + benefits.

$134,000—$167,500 USD

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:

jobs.description:
Salary: £35,000 - £45,000 depending on experience.

Location: Remote-first, flexible working arrangements, with all UK-based locations considered. Our flexible office collaboration spaces, for those wishing to use them, are in London, Exeter, Birmingham and Bristol.

Term: Permanent, full-time (up to 40 hours per week). Reduced hours and flexible working patterns may be considered. Please state any requirements or preferences in your application.

Grade: Consultant.

Closing Date: 13th September 2026. Applications for this position may close early if a suitable candidate is found before the closing date. Early application is recommended.

We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of sex, gender identity, age, disability, ethnicity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

We are only accepting direct applications (no recruiters please).

Unfortunately, we cannot consider applications requiring visa sponsorship now, or in the future.

ABOUT CITY SCIENCE

City Science was founded in 2015 with a core mission of delivering decarbonisation. We help organisations who are committed to decarbonisation achieve meaningful and quantifiable carbon reductions quickly and efficiently. We work collaboratively across our business to provide integrated solutions to our clients. Our range of clients is extensive and includes major bodies such as DESNZ, the Climate Change Committee (CCC), and a range of forward-thinking local authorities. Our business includes award-winning research, software and product development teams who produce innovative and uniquely insightful digital tools, like our GIS software, Cadence, to successfully deliver our projects.

Our Energy & Environment team leads complex consulting commissions across a broad range of technical disciplines and technologies. Examples of the projects we deliver includes:

  • District Heat Network studies (we are a supplier on the Heat Network Zoning DESNZ framework)

  • Local Area Energy Plans (LAEP) and Local Heat & Energy Efficiency Strategies (LHEES)

  • Renewable & Low Carbon Energy Assessments

  • Alternative Fuel Strategies (e.g. Hydrogen, SAF) and Industrial Decarbonisation

  • Technology specific research (such as our DACCS work for the Climate Change Committee)

Further information about some example projects we have delivered can be found on our website.

ABOUT THE ROLE

City Science is seeking a Consultant level candidate who can support delivery of our broad range of consulting commissions in our Energy & Environment Team.

We are particularly interested in candidates with a technical background (e.g. physical sciences or engineering), or those with an economics/finance background but with experience of applying these skills to the energy and low-carbon sectors.

Whilst our preference is for candidates with professional experience (2+ years), we encourage applications from those who have recently completed a relevant PhD. Experience in areas such as district heat networks, carbon accounting (particularly scope 3 emissions), local area energy plans, community energy and renewable energy is highly desirable.

You will contribute to the delivery of projects via research, report writing, analysis, and the production of models. Whilst a key requirement of this role is technical proficiency, we also have an expectation that you will contribute to common consultancy non-technical tasks such as project management, bid writing, stakeholder engagement, and client relationship management. We are a small consultancy, and everyone contributes across a range of activities, supports the achievement of business objectives, and helps identify future opportunities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Consultant within City Science’s Energy & Environment team, you will be responsible for:

· Research, modelling, and analysis across a range of energy and net zero projects

· Data analysis (in Excel predominantly).

· Producing high quality reports and presentations for clients

· Supporting business development and the winning of new work, including preparing proposals, identifying new opportunities and promoting our business.

· Providing quality assurance for projects and technical deliverables

· Build and maintain strong client relationships.

Requirements

ABOUT YOU

You’re motivated, proactive and customer-focused with exceptional attention to detail and the needs of our clients. You have broad technical knowledge and a genuine interest in decarbonisation, sustainability and low carbon solutions.

You’re a great collaborator, committed to the success of the team, with the flexibility to intelligently adapt to the task at hand. Most importantly, you are motivated to deliver high-quality work, solve complex problems and contribute positively to the success of the team.

Essential Requirements

· 2+ years of relevant work experience, or a PhD.

· Degree qualified in a STEM subject, or degree qualified in economics/finance with experience of applying those skills to decarbonisation or sustainability projects and technologies.

· Demonstrable knowledge and understanding across the energy and environment sectors.

· Strong Excel skills and data visualisation capabilities.

· Independent problem solving and ability to develop structured approaches.

· Ability to efficiently produce high-quality reports and documents.

· Ability to communicate technical outputs to a range of technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Desirable

· A PhD, or Master’s degree in finance or a relevant technical discipline.

· Chartered status or working towards chartership.

· Completed project management qualifications (e.g. PRINCE2, APM).

· Knowledge and experience of GIS and coding (e.g. Python).

· Experience of working in a consultancy environment.

· Experience of one or more of: district heat networks, carbon accounting (particularly scope 3 emissions), energy system modelling, local area energy planning, or net zero financing.

If you're excited by this opportunity but don't meet every listed requirement, we encourage you to apply. We recognise that relevant skills and experience can be developed through different routes.

REWARDS & BENEFITS

This role offers:

· The opportunity to work on a diverse range of projects across our consultancy business.

· The opportunity for career progression.

· Ongoing mentoring, training and support from senior professionals within the business (including towards professional chartership).

· Paid membership of one professional institution.

· Flexible working arrangements.

· 25 days annual leave entitlement, plus bank holidays, and ability to buy a further 5 days.

· Membership of our group pension scheme.

· Enhanced maternity and paternity policy.

· Eye care vouchers.

· Cycle to work scheme.

· Employee assistance programme.

FURTHER INFORMATION
We are building a team that is motivated by collaboration and a desire to solve problems for our customers. We want people to take ownership of their area of responsibility, make informed decisions, be proactive and take pride in their work.

Highlights

City Science is seeking a Consultant level candidate who can support delivery of our broad range of consulting commissions in our Energy & Environment Team.

jobs.excerpt: Intetics Inc. , a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced QA Fullstack Engineer to join our dynamic team on a full-time basis.
jobs.description:
Intetics Inc., a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced QA Fullstack Engineer to join our dynamic team on a full-time basis.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain automated test frameworks and test suites across API (REST Assured), web UI (Selenide), and mobile (Appium) layers;
  • Perform manual testing where required, including mobile-specific scenarios (responsiveness, permissions, OS/version coverage, lifecycle testing);
  • Analyze application logs to identify, localize, and help troubleshoot defects;
  • Represent and enforce testing principles within the assigned development team, contributing to the team's overall quality assurance mindset;
  • Where applicable, contribute to accessibility (A11Y) testing efforts;
  • Conduct performance/load testing using JMeter and provide optimization recommendations based on results.

Requirements

  • Manual Testing

- API testing: ability to read API specifications/documentation, independently build a test collection, and test a service using any common tool (Postman, Insomnia, SoapUI, etc.);

- Log analysis: ability to read logs and independently identify or localize defects;

- Mobile testing: familiarity with mobile-specific testing tasks — responsiveness, permissions handling, screen size/OS version coverage, application lifecycle testing.

  • Automation

- Java: confident, object-oriented programming skills; experience building test automation frameworks from scratch; clean, reusable code; familiarity with JUnit, TestNG, Maven/Gradle;

- REST Assured: automated REST API testing; solid grasp of HTTP methods, status codes, JSON, authentication; able to write and parameterize complex API test cases; integration with JUnit/TestNG;

- Selenide: automated UI testing for web applications; knowledge of the Page Object Model; stable, maintainable tests for dynamic interfaces; integration with JUnit/TestNG;

- Appium: automated mobile testing (Android/iOS); experience with emulators/simulators; native and hybrid app testing; CI/CD integration.

Would be a plus:- A11Y (accessibility) testing: awareness of inclusive design principles, WCAG Level A requirements, and practical use of accessibility tools (TalkBack, VoiceOver, NVDA, or JAWS);

- JMeter: performance/load testing; familiarity with Thread Group, Sampler, Listener, Assertion components; ability to load-test APIs, databases, and web applications; results analysis and optimization recommendations.

You’ll work across tools such as Asana, Trello, Monday.com, Smartsheet, and Microsoft Project to ensure projects remain organized, visible, and on track.

  • Track milestones, dependencies, deadlines, and deliverables.
  • Keep project trackers accurate and current.
  • Monitor progress against established schedules.
  • Follow up on overdue or at-risk tasks.

  • Trello
  • Monday.com
  • Smartsheet
  • Microsoft Project

  • Follow up proactively with task owners.
  • Ensure completed work is properly documented.
  • Prevent important deliverables from falling through the cracks.

  • Project Managers
  • Team members
  • Leadership
  • Internal departments
  • Vendors and contractors
  • External stakeholders

You’ll:

  • Communicate project priorities and deadlines clearly.
  • Follow up consistently on outstanding action items.
  • Coordinate information between stakeholders.
  • Document important decisions and next steps.
  • Surface blockers requiring leadership attention.
  • Escalate delays before they impact project timelines.
  • Maintain clear visibility into ownership and accountability.

Responsibilities include:

  • Preparing meeting agendas.
  • Organizing relevant project materials.
  • Taking clear meeting notes.
  • Documenting decisions and action items.

  • Confluence

  • Project plans
  • Meeting notes
  • Action-item trackers
  • Status reports
  • Risk registers
  • Project dashboards
  • Process documentation
  • Supporting project files

Ensure documentation remains current, structured, and easy for stakeholders to access.

Project Status Reporting

  • Overdue tasks
  • Risks and blockers
  • Resource constraints
  • Key dependencies
  • Required decisions
  • Next steps

  • Bottlenecks

  • Resource constraints
  • Communication gaps
  • Quality concerns

  • Track dependencies between teams.
  • Coordinate handoffs between stakeholders.
  • Surface resource constraints.

Business Transformation – Associate Director

Develop strategic blueprints, target operating models, and multi-year transformation roadmaps that sequence near-term wins against structural and strategic changes

jobs.description:
Backend Application Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Backend Application Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer focused on high-throughput platform development to design, build, and operate the foundational platforms and shared services that other engineering teams rely on to deliver their products. This role focuses on building backend platform capabilities — request routing, traffic management, data fan-out, caching layers, asynchronous job execution, and durable event processing — that must handle very high traffic volumes with predictable latency and minimal operational toil. The ideal candidate combines deep distributed systems expertise with strong platform-engineering instincts, values internal developer experience as a first-class concern, and has a track record of leading multi-quarter platform initiatives that meaningfully raise the engineering bar for the organizations they support.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and build internal platform services and shared infrastructure that hundreds of engineers depend on every day, with explicit focus on developer experience and operational ergonomics.
  • Architect high-throughput, latency-sensitive backend platforms capable of sustaining very high request volumes with predictable, well-bounded tail latency.
  • Build durable, replayable event-processing pipelines and asynchronous job execution platforms that other product teams compose to ship features faster.
  • Design and operate caching, rate-limiting, and request-shaping layers that protect upstream systems and enable safe scaling under bursty workloads.
  • Develop platform abstractions, SDKs, and paved-road libraries that codify best practices and let product teams consume capabilities without re-implementing them.
  • Establish robust observability, SLOs, and capacity-planning practices for platform services, raising the operational bar across the organization.
  • Drive multi-region, fault-tolerant, and geo-distributed designs with rigorous attention to availability, durability, and graceful degradation under failure.
  • Lead incident response for high-impact platform issues, conduct blameless post-mortems, and drive durable engineering improvements that prevent recurrence.
  • Define and enforce platform-wide standards around API design, schema evolution, deployment, and backward-compatibility guarantees.
  • Optimize platform performance through careful profiling, data-driven tuning, and algorithmic improvements that move the needle on throughput and cost.
  • Partner with infrastructure, security, and SRE teams to ensure platform services meet enterprise reliability, compliance, and security obligations.
  • Mentor mid-level engineers and lead architectural discussions across teams, helping the broader organization grow in distributed-systems maturity.
  • Produce clear technical design documents, decision records, and operational runbooks that make the platform legible to future maintainers.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging platform technologies, open-source projects, and architectural patterns for strategic adoption.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Six or more years of professional backend or platform engineering experience.
  • Demonstrated track record building and operating internal platforms or shared services consumed by multiple engineering teams.
  • Strong, hands-on expertise designing distributed systems with rigorous attention to consistency, availability, latency, and failure-mode behavior.
  • Advanced proficiency in at least one major backend language such as Java, Go, Scala, Rust, or modern C++.
  • Deep understanding of high-throughput messaging, streaming, and event-driven architectures using technologies such as Kafka, Pulsar, or NATS.
  • Strong working knowledge of data storage systems across relational, key-value, document, and search workloads.
  • Proven experience leading multi-quarter platform initiatives across teams, including stakeholder management and technical decision-making.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including ability to author crisp technical design documents and present trade-offs clearly.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and shape engineering culture through code review, design review, and onboarding contributions.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience operating Kubernetes-based platforms or contributing to internal developer-platform initiatives at scale.
  • Contributions to widely-used open-source platform or infrastructure projects.
  • Familiarity with control-plane / data-plane patterns, service mesh internals, or workflow-orchestration engines.
  • Experience designing platform APIs with strong backward-compatibility and versioning guarantees.

jobs.description:
Credit Sesame is a leading financial wellness platform dedicated to helping consumers achieve better financial health through cutting-edge technology and data-driven solutions. With a decade of credit expertise and a proven track record of serving over 18 million users, Credit Sesame leverages AI and advanced analytics to empower individuals to better understand and manage their credit. Our recently launched Sesame Platform extends our mission by providing financial institutions with a turnkey AI-powered credit intelligence solution.

As our security engineer, you'll own security end-to-end for our platform — standing up open-source tooling, writing your own scripts and automation, and running assessments.

You'll...
  • Run security reviews for new tools, vendors, and projects — data handling, AI usage, DPAs, PII, authentication/authorization, and third-party security reports (SOC 2, PCI, ISO, pentest results);
  • Own access and infrastructure security — IAM least-privilege reviews, S3/database access controls, environment segregation, service-to-service authentication, and network configuration audits (VPC flow logs, inbound/outbound rules);
  • Run vulnerability management across cloud and endpoints, and manage IDS/IPS (e.g., Palo Alto Panorama, AWS WAF) and EDR/MDR tooling;
  • Lead security incident response end to end — triage, investigate, contain, document, and build the runbooks as you go;
  • Implement and maintain the technical controls supporting our PCI DSS and SOC 2 / ISO 27001 compliance programs, including internal audits, risk metrics, and disaster recovery planning;
  • Partner with DevOps/IT on patch management and secure infrastructure defaults, and present tooling and risk recommendations to engineering leadership;
  • Build our in-house AppSec scanning program — evaluate and pilot SAST/SCA/IaC tooling (Semgrep, Trivy, Upwind), integrate into GitLab CI and Jenkins, define severity-based remediation SLAs, and drive rollout across services;
  • Build internal security tooling and automation — custom scripts and integrations (Python/boto3, APIs) that pull data from tools without native integrations into shared dashboards and reports;
  • Build and tune detection pipelines — for example, feeding traffic/bot-protection alerts (Datadome) into our log platform (ELK/Kibana) and writing rules that catch real attack patterns;
  • Threat-model and pentest our AI/LLM systems — scope risks like prompt injection and data exfiltration through MCP servers, coordinate external pentests where needed, and drive remediation;
  • Maintain security policies and practices and drive training and adoption throughout the company.
You're a great fit because...
  • You have 7+ years of hands-on security engineering experience across application security, cloud security, and network/penetration testing — not just one lane;
  • You've driven tooling or architecture decisions independently (evaluated options, made the call, defended it to leadership);
  • You're self-directed, pragmatic, and ruthless about prioritization;
  • You've built production automation from scratch — API integrations, custom collectors, or internal tooling — not just one-off scripts;
  • You have hands-on experience deploying and running OSS security tools — Burp Suite Community/OWASP ZAP, Nmap, Nuclei, Metasploit, Semgrep, Trivy, Wazuh/OSSEC, ELK/Kibana, Prowler/ScoutSuite, HashiCorp Vault, or similar;
  • You have solid AWS security experience;
  • You have working knowledge of PCI DSS, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 — enough to implement controls and support audits;
  • You're curious about emerging security domains and comfortable threat-modeling systems (like AI/LLM applications) that don't have an established playbook yet;
  • You're an excellent communicator who can translate cost/coverage tradeoffs and technical risk for both engineers and executives;
  • Bonus: OSCP, GPEN, or similar certifications; bug bounty experience; prior experience at a startup; or experience securing LLM/AI-based systems;
  • BS in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.

You'll love it here because...

  • You’ll have equity in a pre-IPO company backed by top VCs;
  • We offer comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance;
  • We offer a monthly home office stipend;
  • We offer a professional development program to support your continued growth
  • We offer flexible paid time off;
  • We have 10 paid holidays and additional 6 Sesame Wellness days;
  • We prize EQ and empathy, and have a culture that emphasizes total wellness, including work-life harmony.
At Credit Sesame, base pay is one part of our total compensation package. The estimated pay range for this role is $170,000 - $215,000 with actual salary based on a candidate’s location, qualifications, skills, and experience. Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Credit Sesame’s equity plans.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleBackblaze is building its data function into a governed, product-oriented capability that delivers trusted, auditable, and actionable data across the company.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Backblaze is building its data function into a governed, product-oriented capability that delivers trusted, auditable, and actionable data across the company. The Data Platform & Insights team operates in three layers: Data Engineering makes data reliable (ingestion, pipelines, Snowflake architecture, raw and staging layers), Analytics Engineering makes data trustworthy and reusable (dbt models, the semantic layer, certified metric definitions, lineage, and the data products themselves), and Business Intelligence makes data useful (dashboards, ad hoc analysis, and stakeholder reporting).

This role sits in the middle layer. You will own the shared, reusable transformation and metric logic that everything else depends on. This is not a pipeline or ingestion role, and it is not a dashboard-building role. It is the role that turns landed source data into governed, certified, single-source-of-truth models that the rest of the business consumes.

As an early member of the Analytics Engineering function, you will help define how data products are built and shipped at Backblaze. You will design the dbt models and semantic layer that produce our certified business and financial metrics, eliminate the duplicated and conflicting logic that lives across our reporting tools today, and establish the engineering standards that make our data trustworthy at scale. Because Backblaze is a public company, the models you build directly support financial reporting, so accuracy, lineage, and reconciliation with Finance are core to the work.

This is a high-autonomy, high-leverage role for someone who wants to build a modern analytics foundation from the ground up, not maintain a finished one.

What You’ll Do

Own the transformation layer

  • Design, build, and maintain dbt models from staging through marts, applying software engineering best practices: version control, code review, testing, CI/CD, and documentation
  • Establish and enforce modeling standards, naming conventions, and a tested, documented codebase as the function scales
  • Migrate business logic currently trapped in BI-tool calculated fields and manual SQL into governed, reusable, version-controlled models

Build and own the semantic layer

  • Stand up Backblaze’s semantic layer and define certified, single-source-of-truth metrics such as ARR, MRR, paying customer count, retention, and GTM and funnel metrics
  • Eliminate duplicated and conflicting metric definitions across reports and tools so that one metric means one thing everywhere
  • Partner with Finance, Revenue Operations, and Marketing to align on definitions, grain, and ownership before metrics are certified

Deliver certified data products

  • Build a repeatable pipeline for shipping data products (land, stage, model, certify, expose) so each new product compresses delivery time rather than starting from scratch
  • Deliver core data products such as Revenue, Customer Identity, and Funnel, each with clearly defined schema, grain, owners, tests, and lineage
  • Support financial-reporting-relevant revenue models with full auditability and reconciliation to Finance source numbers

Drive data quality, lineage, and trust

  • Implement testing, data quality checks, and observability so issues are caught before they reach stakeholders
  • Build human-readable lineage and documentation that make it clear how a number is produced from source to metric
  • Raise end-user confidence through discoverability, stewardship, and clear ownership

Partner cross-functionally

  • Translate “build me a report” into defined entities, metrics, grain, and source of truth
  • Work closely with Data Engineering (your upstream) and Business Intelligence (your downstream), and with business stakeholders across Finance, Revenue Operations, and Marketing
  • Build data models that are AI-ready, so that downstream automation and self-service analytics inherit the benefit of a trusted foundation

Right Fit

  • 8+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or a closely related role
  • Advanced SQL, with proven experience building production-grade, well-tested analytical data models
  • Strong hands-on dbt experience: modeling from staging to marts, tests, macros, documentation, and CI/CD
  • Hands-on experience building and running dbt on a modern cloud data warehouse; direct Snowflake strongly preferred
  • Experience building or operating a semantic / metric layer (dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow, Cube, LookML, or a comparable framework)
  • Experience applying software engineering principles to analytical work: Git-based version control, code review, testing, and CI/CD
  • Solid grounding in data modeling (dimensional and/or domain-driven) and in defining metrics and business logic from ambiguous requirements
  • A proactive self-starter who thrives in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and drives projects end to end, from definition through stakeholder onboarding
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with a track record of working effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Able to maintain meaningful working-hours overlap with US Pacific time zone teams

Bonus Points

  • Experience supporting financial reporting, public-company metrics, or SOX-compliant data in a regulated environment
  • Experience with GTM, revenue, and subscription/billing data and systems (Salesforce, Stripe, NetSuite, Orb, or similar)
  • Experience with Tableau or Tableau Next as a consumption layer
  • Proficiency in Python for automation and workflow development
  • Familiarity with pipeline orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Dagster) and ingestion tooling (e.g., Fivetran)
  • Fluency with modern AI tools and coding assistants, applied to accelerate analytical and modeling work

Learning, developing, and growing are key parts of our culture. We're eager to meet people who believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in various ways. jobs.excerpt: In shortWe're looking for an experienced QA Lead to take ownership of quality assurance across our mobile and IoT projects.
jobs.description:
In short

We're looking for an experienced QA Lead to take ownership of quality assurance across our mobile and IoT projects. You'll design test strategies, raise the bar on QA practices, build up the chapter, and mentor a team of testers who already know what they're doing. This is a permanent role: B2B contract, monthly salary, full benefits, and you'd be reporting to the CTO on QA direction across the company.

Why intent?

We've been designing and co-creating connected devices since 2008. Wearables, smart audio, health-tech hardware for clients like Oura and BOSE, backed by investors like a16z and Founders Fund. We're 60+ people, fully remote, and AI-native since before LinkedIn influencers discovered the term. QA here isn't "click through the screens": it's mobile apps talking to firmware over BLE, sensor pipelines, edge cases that only appear at -10°C with a flat battery. The bugs are real, the stakes are real, and good QA leadership changes whether a product ships well or limps out the door.

Who this role is NOT for

If your version of QA leadership is reviewing test cases and writing weekly reports, this isn't going to work. We're not hiring someone to manage a team that already runs itself. We're hiring someone who shapes how testing is done across mobile and IoT projects, decides what tooling we invest in, and pushes the whole chapter forward. If you need full specs to make a call, if "that's not in scope" is a sentence you use often, or if you'd rather not be the one explaining quality trade-offs to a US client at 18:30, we're probably not your people. We're AI-native and we expect you to treat AI as a daily multiplier, not a gimmick.

What you'll do

  • Plan, design, and execute comprehensive testing strategies for IoT and mobile products

  • Lead and mentor the QA team: guide test design, review approaches, run knowledge-sharing

  • Introduce modern QA tools and practices, including test automation and CI/CD integration

  • Define and track quality metrics, and continuously improve testing efficiency

  • Work directly with the CTO on QA direction across the company

  • Collaborate with developers, PMs, and clients to define acceptance criteria and coverage

  • Oversee the full range of testing: compatibility, functional, integration, E2E, automated, performance, security, regression

  • Run quality work end to end: from raw BLE signal capture all the way to cloud data validation

  • Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow, not as a party trick

How we work

Fully remote. We have a pet-friendly office in Warsaw and a coworking space in Gdansk if walls and coffee machines motivate you, but nobody will ask why you're not there. Working hours are flexible: most of the team operates between 10:00 and 18:00 CET, and that's when most meetings happen. Evening calls with US-based clients (up to ~20:00) are part of the rhythm, sometimes a couple of times a week, always planned ahead. You'll lead the QA chapter for the whole company, and at the same time be embedded in a project squad led by a PM for day-to-day delivery.

What you'll get

  • 20,500-28,000 PLN/month net B2B, depending on your experience

  • 26 days of paid leave

  • 10 days of paid sick leave

  • Saltus medical care

  • Self-development budget (2,000 PLN/year)

  • Truly flexible hours: you organize your day

  • Fully remote, with pet-friendly Warsaw office + Gdansk cowork if you want them

  • All necessary equipment provided

  • Internal knowledge-sharing: tech talks, team sessions, library and conference budgets

Your first months

We aim to give you space to ramp up before owning the chapter direction, but this is a real company with real deadlines: if a project needs you sooner, we'll make sure you have the support to hit the ground running. You'll get paired with a buddy, meet the team, and start with real tasks while being guided by leadership. Monthly HR check-ins, real feedback after month two, and a proper review after month three. No one waits three months to tell you something isn't working: if it's great, you'll know; if something needs adjusting, you'll hear about it while there's still time to adjust.

Recruitment process

The entire process is in English. All interviews are recorded for internal evaluation purposes.

  1. Application with a few screening questions

  2. HR call, ~45 min, casual

  3. Short take-home task (~60 min)

  4. Technical meeting, ~90 min, with the CTO

  5. Final feedback within a few days

Once we're in touch, you'll hear from us fast. We don't ghost and we don't drag.

One more thing

intent is an equal opportunity employer. We care about what you can do, not where you come from. Send us your CV and a few words about why this caught your eye. Bonus points if you share an improvement you introduced in a previous QA team that actually moved the needle, the specifics matter more than the title.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years in software testing, ideally mobile and IoT

  • 2+ years leading a QA team, with real ownership of how testing gets done

  • Hands-on with test case management (Qase, TestRail) and the Atlassian stack (Jira, Confluence)

  • Solid manual AND automated testing experience: Cypress, Appium, Postman, Robot Framework

  • Strong understanding of BLE, API testing, and cloud platforms (AWS, Firebase)

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with serious attention to detail

  • English at B2+, written and spoken, because our clients are mostly US-based

  • Leadership mindset: you grow people, you don't just review their work

  • Initiative, ownership, and the kind of communication where people don't have to guess what you meant

Nice to have

  • Hardware-in-the-loop test setups

  • Experience scaling QA practices in a software house or product company

  • Working knowledge of MQTT, NFC, Wi-Fi, Thread, or similar IoT protocols

  • ISTQB Advanced or higher

  • Genuine curiosity about the devices you test, not just the screens on top of them

jobs.description:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

  • Fleetio overview video:
  • Our careers page:

Fleetio is writing a new chapter. We are moving from a well-loved product in a category we helped define to a brand that fleet operators, technicians, and executives recognize at first sight and trust on instinct. We put our name on a NASCAR race. We have a car on track with 23XI Racing. We are rebuilding the company narrative around where fleet operations are actually going — not where it has been.

What we need now is the person who makes it all feel like one thing.

As Senior Director of Brand, you own how Fleetio looks, sounds, and shows up — everywhere. Our visual identity. Our editorial voice. Our social presence and video work. Our earned media. The creative expression of the company story across every surface a customer, a candidate, or an analyst will ever touch. You will lead a talented in-house team and a set of agency partners, and report directly to the CMO on a marketing leadership team being rebuilt for the next stage of growth.

This is a builder’s role, not a caretaker’s. The narrative foundation is being set now. You get to define the expression of it.

Fleetio has a product customers love and a story the market has not yet fully heard. Closing that gap is the single highest-leverage thing marketing can do for this company right now. This seat is where that work lives.

What You’ll Own

  • Brand system and creative. Visual identity, creative direction, and design standards across web, campaign, product surfaces, events, and sponsorship — the system that makes Fleetio recognizable in a category where most brands look interchangeable.
  • Content and thought leadership. Editorial strategy and the content engine — thought leadership, long-form, owned research, and the always-on content that builds authority with fleet leaders and feeds organic and AI-driven search.
  • Social and multimedia. Organic social and video as a real channel, not an afterthought — the presence that keeps Fleetio in the conversation between sales cycles.
  • Communications and PR. Earned media strategy in partnership with our PR agency, executive visibility programs, awards, and the messaging discipline that holds across every external moment.
  • Brand activation. Turning our 23XI Racing partnership and our field presence into a year-round content and storytelling engine — not a logo on a car.
  • Team and partners. Hiring, developing, and leading the brand and content team; owning agency relationships, creative operations, and the intake and prioritization system that lets a small team punch far above its weight.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year:

  • The new Fleetio narrative is live and consistent everywhere — from the homepage to the trade show booth to the sales deck — and it looks and sounds unmistakably like us.
  • Awareness and share of voice move measurably in our favor in the fleet management category.
  • The content engine runs at a cadence demand generation, and sales can actually build on, anchored by at least one owned research franchise, the industry cites.
  • The NASCAR partnership produces story, not just impressions — with a content calendar behind every race weekend.
  • The brand and content team is stronger, clearer on standards, and doing the best work of their careers.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years in brand leadership, including 4+ years leading and developing teams.
  • You have taken a B2B brand — ideally SaaS, ideally at meaningful scale — through a narrative or identity evolution, and shipped it into market. Not just designed it. Shipped it.
  • You have real taste, editorial and visual, and the judgment to know when good enough ships and when it does not.
  • You are comfortable being measured. Awareness, share of voice, engagement, content-influenced pipeline — you can hold a number and defend it in front of a CEO.
  • You are a genuine partner to product marketing, demand generation, events, and customer marketing. Brand does not work in a room by itself.
  • You have managed agencies well — gotten more out of them than the retainer suggested.
  • You like real-world industries. Our buyers are fleet managers, technicians, and operations leaders. They are not marketers, and they can smell marketing from a mile away.

About the Team

About the Role

ServiceNow is looking for a Principal Inbound Product Manager to build the evaluation and feedback backbone that makes our AI-powered support products trustworthy, measurable, and continuously improving. We are investing in building structured mechanism for statistical sampling, human review, or feedback capture that closes the loop back into the product. This role owns enabling that mechanism from the ground up, and applying it consistently across all AI-enabled products in the portfolio.

This is an inbound-facing role: your primary customers are the product teams and Customer Support teams across the organization, and your core deliverable is the evaluation & governance infrastructure, taxonomy, and process that lets every AI feature get measurably better over time.

What You'll Own

  • End-to-end design of the AI product evaluation ecosystem: automated evals, human-in-the-loop review, and a structured feedback taxonomy applied consistently across the organization's AI-enabled support capabilities.

  • Cross-functional coordination across Product, AI/ML Engineering, Data & Telemetry, and AI Operations to unify how feedback is captured, reviewed, and actioned.
  • The requirements and prioritization inputs that drive continuous improvement in resolution quality and effectiveness, benefiting both internal support teams and external customers.

Why This Role Matters

  • Own the foundational trust layer for ServiceNow's AI-powered support products at a moment when the company is scaling AI features faster than it can currently validate them.
  • Shape how ServiceNow itself, not just our customers — operationalizes responsible, data-driven AI product development, with direct executive visibility.
  • Sit at the intersection of product, data science, and operations, with the mandate to build something that doesn't exist today rather than optimize an existing process.

  • High-leverage, cross-functional scope: your work becomes the shared standard every AI feature across the org and measured against.

What Success Looks Like

  • A structured evaluation ecosystem (automated evals, human review cadence, feedback taxonomy) live and adopted across all major AI-enabled support products.
  • A functioning closed-loop process, with measurable improvement in resolution quality tied to feedback findings.
  • Demonstrated progress toward company-wide goals for AI-driven issue resolution, with feedback insights as a contributing driver.
  • AI product and engineering teams actively using the evaluation framework as part of their standard development cycle, not as an afterthought.

jobs.title: Service Delivery Manager
jobs.excerpt: The Team Service Delivery is the backbone of ServiceNow's customer success strategy in the Americas.
jobs.description:
The Team

Service Delivery is the backbone of ServiceNow's customer success strategy in the Americas. We manage the governance, performance, and strategic alignment of our global system integrator (SI) and service delivery partners ensuring that partner-delivered services meet the highest standards of quality, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes. The Service Delivery function spans partner capacity planning, contingent worker onboarding, contract management, resource optimization, and end-to-end delivery governance across a large ecosystem of delivery partners serving thousands of customers.

As a Service Delivery Manager, you will be part of a team supporting the Director, Service Delivery in executing the regional service delivery strategy and governance frameworks. Your focus will be on the tactical, day-to-day oversight and governance of assigned partner engagements, ensuring consistent execution of ServiceNow standards, quality metrics, and customer outcomes.

The Role

The Service Delivery Manager is responsible for overseeing the performance, quality, and operational health of assigned partners. Acting as the primary governance point between ServiceNow and delivery partner(s) for your assigned portfolio, you ensure partner resources assigned to ServiceNow engagements are delivered in accordance with agreed service levels, quality standards, contractual commitments, and customer outcome expectations.

You monitor service delivery performance, identify risks, drive corrective actions, manage escalations, and provide ongoing visibility into delivery health for leadership. Your role serves as the critical accountability layer that makes partner performance predictable, scalable, and aligned to ServiceNow standards across your assigned partners, regardless of whether they are delivering managed services, outsourced operations, subcontracted services, or project-based engagements. You work closely with the Director, Service Delivery to implement governance processes, contribute to strategic initiatives, and escalate systemic issues that require regional leadership attention.

Responsibilities

Partner Performance Governance

  • Serve as the primary ServiceNow point of contact for assigned partner points of contact; maintaining day-to-day oversight of partner service performance against contracted KPIs and SLAs.
  • Monitor service delivery performance across assigned partners, tracking key metrics including quality scores, customer satisfaction, utilization rates, delivery timelines, and cost-per-outcome performance; ensuring that ServiceNow and its customers are getting excellence in delivery from its partner resources.
  • Review delivery quality trends, audit findings, and operational metrics to identify systemic issues, root causes, and opportunities for continuous improvement within assigned portfolio.
  • Monitor delivery unit economics and cost-per-outcome performance, ensuring the contracted commercial model (unit-based, outcome-based, or hybrid) tracks to delivered value and flag discrepancies.
  • Maintain a dashboard or reporting view of assigned partner health metrics and escalate systemic issues to the Director, Service Delivery for strategic resolution or cross-regional alignment.

Escalation & Corrective Action

  • Lead delivery escalations across ServiceNow and partner teams for assigned engagements, driving timely issue resolution and ensuring accountability for remediation plans and service recovery activities.
  • Document escalation history, track resolution status, and report escalation trends to the Director, Service Delivery and relevant stakeholders.
  • Identify patterns in escalations across assigned partners and recommend process improvements or capability enhancements to the Director.
  • Partner with customer success teams and account teams to protect customer outcomes and address service delivery risks impacting customer health.

Onboarding & Service Transitions

  • Own tracking and acceptance of transition and mobilization milestones during partner onboarding or service transitions, including staffing ramp against plan, capability/certification readiness, and transition exit criteria.
  • Ensure partner resource skills and certifications align with service demands and customer requirements, tracking ongoing development and readiness.
  • Communicate onboarding milestones and status to leadership and document lessons learned from transitions.
  • Support the Director in partner capacity planning by tracking staffing ramps, utilization, and capability readiness for assigned partners.

Operational Governance & Reporting

  • Manage the operational governance cadence for assigned partners, including weekly performance check-ins, monthly reviews, and quarterly business review preparation.
  • Own capacity and demand management processes for assigned partners, including utilization tracking, variance planning, and periodic reconciliation against contracted volumes.
  • Manage the change control process for operational or initiative requests that have contractual implications, engaging Commercial Management as needed.
  • Flag discrepancies between service delivery status and invoicing or milestone payment triggers to Commercial and Finance stakeholders.
  • Produce and maintain performance reporting for assigned partners, providing regular updates to the Director and internal leadership stakeholders.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in response to changes in tooling, operating model, or service delivery requirements.

Collaboration & Coordination

  • Coordinate with other Service Delivery Managers in the region and across geographies on initiative design, sequencing, and rollout to ensure consistency.
  • Maintain regular interlock with the Global Partnerships and Channels (GPC) team, ensuring partner performance insights, escalations, and capability needs are escalated appropriately.
  • Support the Director in implementing regional governance frameworks and standard operating procedures across partner-delivered services.
  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives with Commercial Management, Finance, Sales, and Customer Excellence Group to support partner relationship development.

Core Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in service delivery management, vendor governance, partner performance management, or a related operational role within a global technology or SaaS environment.
  • Demonstrated experience managing partner, vendor, or supplier performance through structured governance frameworks, scorecards, and business reviews.
  • Proven ability to manage third-party performance against defined SLAs and KPIs, including escalation and corrective action processes.
  • Experience managing partners in a Customer Success and Professional Services delivery context.
  • Track record of driving continuous improvement and service efficiencies in partner or vendor management environments.

Operational & Functional Skills

  • Experience designing and maintaining operational documentation, including playbooks and standard operating procedures.
  • Strong project and program management capability, with a track record of delivering cross-functional initiatives to agreed timelines.
  • Proficiency in performance data analysis and reporting, with the ability to draw actionable conclusions from KPI and operational metrics.
  • Experience monitoring and tracking partner resource ongoing development of skills and certifications in line with service demands.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate across functions and levels of seniority without direct line authority.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and presentation skills with ability to clearly articulate performance insights to partner leadership and internal stakeholders.

ServiceNow & Domain Knowledge

  • Knowledge of, or ability to rapidly develop proficiency in, ServiceNow's platform and products.
  • Familiarity with Customer Success and Professional Services metrics and post-sales operating models, including NPS, utilization, rate cards, and product adoption measures.
  • Understanding of professional services delivery models, partner economics, and how partner governance supports customer outcomes.
  • Ability to balance customer outcomes, business objectives, and partner performance requirements in a complex operating environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within or alongside a Partner or managed service delivery model, particularly in a vendor governance or service integration capacity.
  • Familiarity with scaled SaaS operating models, AI Native environments, and partner-delivered service motions.
  • Experience operating within an organizational transformation or operational improvement program in a post-sales or customer success context.
  • Certifications in relevant disciplines (e.g., PMP, ITIL, CSM, COPC, supplier management).
  • Exposure to AI-enabled or agentic workflow tooling within an operational team environment.
  • Experience with India-based or nearshore service delivery models and geographically distributed partner teams.
  • Prior experience at ServiceNow or within the ServiceNow ecosystem.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on Technical Team Lead to lead the global build and technical integration of Full MVNO systems. In this role, you will lead a dedicated Build Team responsible for architecting, integrating, testing, and commissioning end-to-end Full MVNO capabilities across global markets.

Operating under a Build-to-Run model, you and your team will build new MVNO capabilities and host MNO integrations from the ground up, execute rigorous testing, and hand over stable, operational systems to a dedicated Run team after launch. This role is ideal for someone with deep technical expertise in Mobile Core networks across voice, VoLTE, data, and SMS, strong knowledge of telecommunications regulations, and experience leading engineering and QA teams.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead, mentor and manage a team of around five engineers and QA specialists, owning sprint planning, task allocation and technical reviews across concurrent global rollout streams.
  • Establish engineering best practices, integration templates, automated testing strategy and technical handover standards.
  • Lead technical integrations with host mobile network operators globally, across signalling, packet core, voice and messaging.
  • Own the architecture and setup of Full MVNO core components, from the subscriber database (HSS/HLR) through packet core, signalling routing and messaging platforms.
  • Direct implementation and troubleshooting across the signalling stack, including Diameter and SS7.
  • Own end-to-end service readiness across data, voice and SMS, covering session management, policy enforcement, data routing, VoLTE, legacy circuit-switched voice and international interconnects.
  • Design and validate mobile number portability routing in line with country-specific regulatory frameworks.
  • Own regulatory compliance for each market, covering lawful interception (ETSI ES 201 671 / TS 102 232, HI1/HI2/HI3) and emergency service routing such as e112, 911 and 999.
  • Partner with QA on integration test plans, stress testing and acceptance testing, then drive Operational Readiness Reviews and clean documented handovers to the 24/7 Run team after launch.

What You'll Bring:

  • 5+ years hands-on in mobile core networks and Full MVNO integrations.
  • 2+ years leading a team of engineers and/or QA specialists in an agile or delivery-focused environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of both packet core and voice core, including the subscriber database (HSS/HLR), policy and charging, VoLTE and legacy circuit-switched voice.
  • Expertise across the signalling stack, including Diameter, SS7 and SIP.
  • Experience with messaging architecture and SMS routing, including interworking with other operators.
  • Proven experience delivering mobile number portability and lawful interception solutions.
  • Strong delivery mindset across multiple concurrent rollout streams, with clear communication and the ability to produce documentation good enough to hand a system over on.

Nice to have

  • Automation experience: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible), containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes) or automated signalling test frameworks.
  • Hands-on with core MVNO vendors such as Nokia, Ericsson, Mavenir, Oracle Communications, Cisco, Summa Networks, NetNumber or XIUS.
  • Cloud-native or virtualised network functions on AWS, Azure, GCP or private cloud.
  • Degree in telecommunications engineering, computer science, electrical engineering or similar.

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world.

jobs.excerpt: SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.
jobs.description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As an AI Tutor specialized in multilingual audio capabilities, you will contribute to SpaceXAI's mission by training and refining Grok to excel in voice interactions, speech recognition, and auditory experiences across diverse languages, accents, and cultural contexts. Your work will focus on curating and annotating high-quality audio data to enhance Grok's global accessibility, enabling natural spoken interactions for users worldwide, bridging language barriers through accurate speech processing, and improving the AI's handling of multilingual audio nuances.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Use proprietary software to provide labels, annotations, recordings, and inputs on projects involving multilingual audio clips, voice recordings, speech samples, and auditory elements in various languages.
  • Support the delivery of high-quality curated audio data that ensures clear, natural spoken output, accurate representation of linguistic and prosodic details (such as intonation, rhythm, and accent), and professional audio standards.
  • Collaborate with technical staff to develop tasks that improve AI's ability to handle speech modulation, accent variation, noise in real-world recordings, and multilingual audio processing.
  • Work with technical staff to improve annotation tools for efficient audio workflows.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Native proficiency inUrdu with exposure to diverse accents, dialects, or regional variations.
  • Proficiency in English (minimum B2 level) with clear, natural vocal delivery and pronunciation suitable for audio recording purposes.
  • Strong auditory perception to identify nuances in speech, accents, pronunciation, intonation, and audio quality across languages.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multilingual audio content, including evaluating speech accuracy, cultural vocal expressions, and contextual interpretation in spoken form.
  • Demonstrated ability to transcribe audio with high accuracy across accents and varying audio quality.
  • Comfort providing high-quality voice recordings and feedback on audio samples in multiple languages.
  • Strong comprehension skills and the ability to make independent judgments on ambiguous or varied audio material, including noisy or accented speech.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, analytical, detail-oriented, and organizational skills, with the ability to articulate audio-related feedback effectively.
  • Commitment to developing AI that masters sophisticated multilingual audio capabilities.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Demonstration of exceptional attention to linguistic nuance, auditory detail, and data quality beyond standard transcription work.
  • Deep understanding and taste of what good/useful Audio data is.
  • Strong command of advanced transcription and annotation practices, including handling disfluencies, accents, and prosodic features (intonation, stress, rhythm, emotion, etc) with high consistency and accuracy.
  • Background in linguistics (e.g., phonetics, phonology, sociolinguistics), speech sciences, cognitive science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with demonstrated ability to analyze accent variation, pronunciation differences, and multilingual speech patterns.
  • Experience working with speech/audio datasets, annotation workflows, or AI training data, including knowledge/experience with training voice models, and an understanding of how data quality impacts model performance.
  • Professional experience in voice work, including voice acting, voice recording, podcasting with a measurable audience (e.g., X following), or similar audio production demonstrating attention to clarity and recording quality.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise independent judgment in ambiguous audio scenarios and make consistent, defensible annotation decisions.
  • Portfolio (strongly preferred for advanced candidates): Voice samples, annotated transcripts, or audio-related work demonstrating quality, methodology, and attention to detail.
  • Candidates with professional experience in voice, linguistics, speech data, or speech evaluation and research are especially encouraged to apply.

LOCATION AND OTHER EXPECTATIONS:

  • Tutor roles may be offered as full-time, part-time, or contractor positions, depending on role needs and candidate fit.
  • For contractor positions, hours will vary widely based on project scope and contractor availability, with no fixed commitments required. On average, most projects may require at least 10 hours per week to deliver effectively, though this is not a fixed commitment and depends on the scope of work. Contractors have full flexibility to set their own hours and determine the exact amount of time needed to complete deliverables.
