jobs.description:
Job Description:

Web Developer – .NET, Blazor and Azure - C-SAM UK

C-SAM develops specialist asset management, rental, service, certification and operational software for customers operating across the UK and international markets.
We are currently investing heavily in the development of our next-generation web application framework. This framework will modernise our established Windows-based software and provide a scalable, secure and configurable cloud platform for both existing and new customers.
We are looking for a practical and experienced Web Developer to join our development team and help build, improve and deliver this new platform.

The Web Developer will work primarily on C-SAM’s newest web application framework, developing reusable components, customer-facing modules, integrations and core platform functionality.
You will work across the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment and ongoing improvement.
The role will also involve understanding and, where required, migrating functionality from our existing VB.NET, WinForms and SQL Server applications into the new web platform.
This is a hands-on development role suited to someone who enjoys solving real business problems, working with complex workflows and building software that is reliable, maintainable and easy for users to operate.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain functionality within C-SAM’s new .NET web application framework.
• Build reusable Blazor components, shared services and configurable application modules.
• Develop responsive and user-friendly web interfaces.
• Convert existing Windows application functionality into modern web-based workflows.
• Work with product owners, operational teams and customers to understand business requirements.
• Design and implement secure, scalable and maintainable solutions.
• Develop and optimise Entity Framework queries and data access services.
• Create and maintain SQL Server stored procedures, views, functions and scripts.
• Improve application and database performance.
• Build integrations with customer systems, third-party APIs and cloud services.
• Assist with data migration, cleansing and validation activities.
• Develop authentication, role-based access and permission functionality.
• Support multi-company, multi-entity and multi-customer application structures.
• Write unit tests and assist with integration, regression and user acceptance testing.
• Diagnose and resolve software defects and performance issues.
• Review code and contribute to development standards and architecture decisions.
• Produce clear technical documentation and implementation notes.
• Support application deployments to Azure environments.
• Work with AI-assisted development tools, including OpenAI Codex, to improve development speed and quality.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the framework, development processes and coding standards.

Essential Skills and Experience

• Strong commercial experience developing applications using C# and .NET.
• Experience developing web applications using Blazor Server, Blazor WebAssembly, ASP.NET Core or a similar Microsoft web technology.
• Strong SQL Server knowledge, including:
o T-SQL
o Stored procedures
o Views
o Joins and aggregations
o Query optimisation
o Indexing
o Execution plans
o Data migration scripts
• Experience using Entity Framework or Entity Framework Core.
• Good understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles.
• Experience developing REST APIs and integrating with third-party services.
• Experience with dependency injection and service-based application architecture.
• Experience using Git and source control workflows.
• Good understanding of application security, authentication and role-based permissions.
• Ability to investigate and resolve complex technical and business problems.
• Ability to work with existing applications and understand established business logic.
• Strong attention to detail and a focus on producing reliable, supportable software.
• Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within a small development team.

Desirable Skills and Experience

The following experience would be beneficial but is not essential:

• VB.NET development experience.

• WinForms or WPF application development.
• Experience modernising or migrating desktop applications to web technologies.
• Crystal Reports development and support.
• Experience converting Crystal Reports into web-based or alternative reporting solutions.
• Microsoft Azure experience, including:
o Azure App Service
o Azure SQL Database
o Azure Storage
o Azure Functions
o Application Insights
o Key Vault
o Azure DevOps
o Microsoft Entra ID
• Experience with Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL), single sign-on or multi-factor authentication.
• Experience building multi-tenant or multi-company SaaS applications.
• Experience with MAUI or cross-platform application development.
• Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript and responsive web design.
• Experience with component libraries such as Ignite UI.
• Experience developing dashboards, charts and operational reporting.
• Knowledge of background processing, scheduled services and message queues.
• Experience with document generation, barcode printing, label printing or local printing services.
• Experience integrating accounting, shipping, CRM, ERP or asset management systems.
• Experience working with AI development tools such as OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot or Azure AI services.
• Knowledge of prompt design, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation or vector search.
• Familiarity with secure software development practices and standards such as ISO 27001.
• Experience working within rental, asset management, service, maintenance, logistics or certification-based industries.

Technical Environment

The successful candidate is likely to work with technologies including:

  • C#
  • VB.NET
  • .NET and ASP.NET Core
  • Blazor Server
  • Entity Framework Core
  • SQL Server
  • Azure SQL Database
  • REST APIs
  • HTML and CSS
  • JavaScript
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Microsoft Entra ID and MSAL
  • Git and Azure DevOps
  • Crystal Reports
  • WinForms and WPF
  • .NET MAUI
  • OpenAI Codex and Azure AI services

Personal Characteristics

  • Practical and solutions-focused, with a passion for delivering business value.

  • Commercially aware, with the ability to connect technical solutions to business needs.

  • Confident working within complex and established technology environments.

  • Accountable, proactive, and committed to seeing work through to completion.

  • Focused on quality, maintainability, performance, security, and reliability.

  • Open to change, continuous improvement, and innovation.

  • Strong communicator with the ability to engage a wide range of stakeholders.

  • Adaptable and effective in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Committed to the responsible use of AI and modern technologies to improve outcomes and efficiency.

Qualifications and Experience

• A degree or equivalent qualification in software development, computer science or a related subject is desirable.
• Equivalent commercial experience will also be considered.
• Previous experience in a commercial software development role is required.
• Experience delivering business-critical software to external customers would be advantageous.

Working Arrangements

This role will involve working closely with C-SAM’s development, operations, professional services and management teams.
The position may be office-based, hybrid or remote depending on the successful candidate’s location and experience.
Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, customer workshops, implementation support or training.
Some flexibility may occasionally be required when supporting international customers operating in different time zones.

What We Offer

• The opportunity to help shape a new application framework and product platform.
• A varied role involving new development, architecture, integrations and modernisation.
• Exposure to international customers and complex operational software.
• The opportunity to work with modern Microsoft and AI technologies.
• A small-team environment where individual contributions have a visible impact.
• Opportunities to influence technical direction, development standards and future products.
• Ongoing professional development and training.

Measures of Success

Success in the role will include:

• Delivering reliable functionality within agreed timescales.
• Producing maintainable and reusable framework components.
• Reducing defects and support issues through good design and testing.
• Improving application and database performance.
• Supporting the successful migration of Windows functionality into the web platform.
• Contributing positively to development standards, documentation and team knowledge.
• Using AI-assisted development tools effectively while maintaining appropriate code quality, security and review controls.
• Helping deliver a secure, scalable and commercially successful web platform.

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

We willen dat iedereen in Nederland de best mogelijke hypotheek heeft. Ons team bestaat uit meer dan 30 Fritsers die dagelijks Frits beter, slimmer, klantvriendelijker, bekender en leuker maken. Dat doen we samen. We dagen elkaar uit en staan voor elkaar klaar. Zo maken we die ambitie werkelijkheid. Wij zijn Frits.

Wat je van ons kunt verwachten

Wij helpen je graag goed op weg. Daarom zorgen wij ervoor dat de leads die je binnenkrijgt, van hoge kwaliteit zijn. Je helpt klanten om hen zo goed mogelijk inzicht te krijgen in de mogelijkheden. Met de hulp van onze slimme software. Die berekent alles in no-time en denkt meerdere scenario’s voor je uit. Zo kun jij je focussen op de klant.

Flexibiliteit is belangrijk. Je bent vrij om zelf je agenda in te delen en je uren te bepalen. Wil je naast je werk ook eigen klanten adviseren? Ga ervoor. Zelf kiezen waar je werkt? Jij bepaalt. En ga je op vakantie? Dan is er een team Fritsers die je klanten tijdelijk kunnen overnemen.

Waarom je bij ons past

Je houdt ervan om grenzen te verleggen. En ook van nieuwe dingen leren. Je levert graag mooie resultaten en zet alles op alles om klanten goed te helpen. Je werkt makkelijk samen en ziet niet snel dingen over het hoofd. Klinkt bekend? Dan voel je je hier als een vis in ‘t water.

Requirements

  • Je werkt al minimaal vijf jaar als adviseur.

  • Je hebt ervaring met klanten uit verschillende situaties. Denk aan starters, verhuizers, oversluiters of ondernemers.

  • Je hebt up-to-date WFT’s op zak.

Diversiteit & Inclusiviteit

Bij Frits is iedereen welkom. We vinden het superbelangrijk dat de werkomgeving van iedere Fritser veilig voelt en inclusief is. Onafhankelijk van wie je bent of waar je vandaan komt. Diversiteit maakt ons juist sterker, beter en zorgt ervoor dat we een open en heldere blik hebben. Om dit te behouden hebben we een sollicitatieprocedure opgezet waar iedereen gelijke kansen krijgt om aangenomen te worden. Welkom bij de Frits Family.

Extra informatie

Beloningsmodel

Bij Frits werken we met een beloningsmodel dat net even anders is. Zo krijg je bij ons geen uurtarief of stukloon maar word je betaald per fase: zo hebben we een oriëntatie-, advies- en bemiddelingsfase. jobs.excerpt: Senior C++ Software EngineerRemote (UK-based) | Full-TimeAbout UsReactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year ().
jobs.description:
Senior C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer who can shape the technical direction of our Switchboard trading platform while continuing to write excellent code. You'll work on the most performance-critical components — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together — and you'll have a direct influence on architectural decisions that affect the entire platform.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Beyond your own delivery, you'll provide technical oversight across the team — reviewing designs, challenging assumptions, and mentoring engineers who are earlier in their careers. You'll help us maintain the quality bar that our clients depend on, and you'll contribute to the architectural decisions that determine how well our platform scales.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

  • Architectural oversight — solution design, peer reviews, and technical direction for platform components

  • Mentorship — helping junior and mid-level engineers develop their skills, improve their code, and grow into stronger contributors

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (5+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Proven track record of optimising complex, latency-sensitive systems — you can profile, diagnose, and fix performance problems methodically

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and network protocols (TCP/UDP, socket programming, FIX)

  • Experience with system design and architectural trade-offs — you've made decisions that stuck and lived with the consequences

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You conduct thoughtful peer reviews, challenge designs constructively, and hold the team to high standards without slowing it down

  • You mentor. You invest in the engineers around you — sharing knowledge, pairing on hard problems, and helping people grow. You make the team better, not just the code

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems — trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • Technical influence — direct input into architectural decisions, solution design, and the technical direction of the platform

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to lead roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

jobs.title: Design Systems Lead
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreImprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

The Opportunity

  • Define and drive the long-term vision and roadmap for Imprint's design system, balancing immediate product needs with long-term platform investments

  • Partner deeply with Product Design, Engineering, Product Management, and AI teams to ensure system components are scalable, maintainable, production-ready, and aligned to shared priorities

  • Establish governance, contribution models, and decision-making frameworks that give product teams a shared source of truth and let them move faster without sacrificing quality or consistency

  • Evolve the design system beyond traditional Figma libraries and Storybook documentation toward machine-readable, AI-consumable foundations that connect design tooling, code generation, and AI-assisted development

  • Mentor a small team of design systems designers and partner with developers, raising the bar on systems thinking, prioritization, and ownership across the group

  • Stay hands-on by contributing directly to component architecture, documentation, patterns, and guidelines, and by leading complex initiatives from strategy through execution

Your Profile

Required

  • 8+ years of product design experience, including significant design systems ownership and experience leading or managing design systems teams

  • Demonstrated success building and scaling design systems used across multiple product teams in a production environment

  • Deep understanding of component architecture, design tokens, accessibility standards, and design-to-development workflows

  • Strong product judgment with the ability to prioritize high-impact work and make tradeoffs between near-term product needs and long-term system investments

  • Experience partnering closely with frontend engineers and engineering leadership to ship system components that are actually adopted and trusted

  • Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment where you own both the strategy and the execution, and where the system needs to evolve continuously

  • Excellent ability to communicate and influence across functions, including educating and advocating for design systems with teams that haven't worked with one before

Nice to Have

  • Experience with modern frontend technologies, component-based development, Storybook, and design token infrastructure

  • Experience with AI-assisted design, code generation, or agent-driven workflows, particularly in exploring how AI transforms the way products are designed and built

  • Background in design engineering or highly technical product environments where the line between design and development is intentionally blurred

  • Experience building design systems in high-growth startup environments where the system had to scale alongside rapid product expansion

We don't expect every candidate to check every box. If this role excites you and you bring strong fundamentals, we encourage you to apply.

Stack

Figma, Storybook, design tokens. Frontend component libraries (React/TypeScript). AI-assisted design and development tooling.

Learn More

Learn more about how we build at Imprint on our engineering blog:

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Leading configured work computers of your choice

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

  • Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

Compensation Range: $190K - $250K

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer (TypeScript/Node.js)
jobs.excerpt: About UtorgFounded in 2019, Utorg builds the infrastructure for stablecoin payments: on- and off-ramps, self-custodial wallets, and crypto cards.
jobs.description:
About Utorg

Founded in 2019, Utorg builds the infrastructure for stablecoin payments: on- and off-ramps, self-custodial wallets, and crypto cards. Over 2 million users across 130+ countries already buy, hold, and spend crypto through our app. On the B2B side, the same rails power 2,100+ platforms, with $2.4B+ moved to date.

Fully MiCA-authorized across the EEA. PCI DSS Level 2 certified. Backed by Dragonfly, TA Ventures, and Hypra.

Location: Remote

Tech stack: TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, TypeORM, NATS JetStream, Redis, Jest, Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform.

Blockchains: EVM-compatible, Bitcoin-family, Tron, Solana, TON.

What you’ll do:
  • Own backend architecture across two large-scale microservice platforms (30+ and 25+ services) — from system design and API contracts to data flow and inter-service communication.
  • Lead complex integrations — payment providers, card issuers, blockchain networks, third-party APIs — and take full responsibility for their reliability in production.
  • Drive performance and scalability — identify bottlenecks, design caching strategies, optimize database queries, and ensure the platform handles growing load.
  • Shape technical direction — make architectural decisions, evaluate trade-offs, and influence the team’s engineering standards. You’ll partially offload the Tech Lead so the team can scale.
  • Build and improve AI-powered processes — our team actively uses LLM-based systems to automate operational and development workflows. You’ll contribute to and extend this direction.
  • Contribute to back-office frontends (~20% of your time) — maintain and extend React-based admin dashboards used by internal teams.
  • Own features end-to-end — from planning and architectural design to implementation, testing, production monitoring, and iterative improvement.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, QA, and cross-functional teams — produce clear technical documentation, participate in code reviews, and share knowledge.
  • Take part in a shared on-call rotation — roughly one week a month.
Who you are:
  • Technically strong with an architectural mindset — you don’t just write code, you design systems. You think about data flows, failure modes, and long-term maintainability before writing the first line.
  • Opinionated and able to defend your decisions — you bring an expert perspective to technical discussions and can articulate trade-offs clearly to both engineers and stakeholders.
  • Proactive problem-solver — you find issues before they become incidents and propose solutions without waiting to be asked.
  • Product-driven — most of your time goes into shipping features and solving real user problems, not open-ended refactoring.
  • Self-motivated and responsible — you thrive in small teams, enjoy autonomy, and take full ownership of the development process.
What you will bring:
  • 5+ years of production experience in backend development with Type Script/Node.js as the primary stack.
  • 2+ years with NestJS in production — modules, providers, middleware, guards, interceptors, microservice architecture with custom transports.
  • Deep PostgreSQL expertise — schema design, indexing (partial, GIN/GiST), query optimization, migrations with zero-downtime, database-per-service pattern.
  • Hands-on microservices experience — not a monolith split into modules. You’ve dealt with inter-service communication (RPC + pub/sub), message brokers, idempotency, eventual consistency, saga/outbox patterns.
  • System design experience — decomposing services, designing API contracts, data flow architecture, capacity planning. You can whiteboard a system and explain why you made each decision.
  • Complex integration experience — you’ve built and maintained integrations with third-party APIs, payment systems, or similar external services in production. You know how to handle retries, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation.
  • Performance engineering— profiling, caching strategies, load analysis, bottleneck identification. You can optimize a slow query and a slow service alike.
  • Production blockchain experience (MUST-HAVE) — you’ve worked with on-chain transactions, multiple networks, and real user funds. You understand HD wallets (BIP32/BIP39), smart contracts, ABI, ERC-20/SPL tokens, and the differences between account-based and UTXO models. Experience with libraries like ethers.js, viem, and solana/web3.js.
  • AI-driven development (MUST-HAVE) — you actively use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor) in your daily workflow. Beyond personal productivity, you have experience optimizing business or organizational processes with AI/LLMs—building automations, internal tools, or workflows powered by language models.
  • Strong testing discipline — unit tests (Jest), integration tests with real databases, microservice testing.
  • Security-conscious — in fintech and crypto, every code path can touch real user funds. You build accordingly.
  • Skilled in technical research — evaluating trade-offs, testing hypotheses, and making data-driven architectural decisions.
  • English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate. Fluent in the Russian language.
Nice to have:
  • Experience with NATS JetStream as a transport layer (streams, consumers, delivery policies).
  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus + Grafana, structured logging (pino), distributed tracing.
  • Kubernetes beyond basics: Kustomize/Helm, deployment strategies, resource management.
  • Fintech domain knowledge: PCI DSS, GDPR, KYC/AML, payment systems.
  • Experience mentoring junior/middle developers.
  • React basics for back-office UIs (functional components, hooks, Redux, Material-UI).

Interaction with other teams:

Close collaboration with Product, QA, Frontend, and Mobile. Cross-functional communication is an essential part of the role. Partially offload the Tech Lead: own architectural and technical decisions, independently drive complex integrations, and influence the platform's technical direction. This is not an executor role. We need someone with strong expert opinions who can be relied upon for key technical decisions.

Key results (30-60-90):

30 days: First features shipped to production. Deep dive into the stack, architecture, and domain (blockchain, fintech). Clear understanding of core services and how they interact.

60 days: Independently drives a complex integration or a major feature. Participates in architectural code reviews. Brings first proposals for improvements.

90 days: Makes architectural decisions on their scope. Influences technical direction. Partially offloads the Tech Lead in decision-making. Participates in planning.

What we offer:
  • Work fully remote as part of an agile, international team reshaping the future of finance.
  • An engineering culture that encourages the adoption of modern tools and development practices, giving engineers real influence over technologies, workflows, and technical decisions.
  • Two career tracks — grow into Tech Lead or deepen your expertise as Staff/Principal IC. You choose the path.
  • Career progression and professional development in a forward-thinking fintech environment.
  • Competitive salary range based on individual performance review.
  • Transparent feedback and a culture that values ownership, open dialogue, and visible impact.
Recruitment Process

  1. Application. Submit your application and CV.

  2. Application Review. Our team reviews your experience and qualifications.

  3. HR Interview. An introductory conversation to discuss your professional background and expectations.

  4. Technical Interview. Assessment of your technical expertise, system design skills, and relevant experience.

  5. Team Lead Interview. A discussion focused on team fit, collaboration style, and alignment with engineering culture.

  6. Offer. Receiving the offer and details about the next steps.

Ми надаємо послуги по всьому світу, підтримуючи клієнтів 60-ма мовами, співпрацюємо з такими лідерами як MasterCard, Calm та MacPaw, маємо міжнародні хаби, а також розробляємо такі інноваційні продукти, як Quidget — щоб робити клієнтський досвід кращим кожного дня.

Про позицію:

Ми шукаємо досвідченого DevOps інженера до нашої Infrastructure команди, що допоможе підтримувати інфраструктуру на найвищому рівні. Маєш від 3 років досвіду у системному чи мережевому адмініструванні та бажаєш стати частиною міжнародної команди? Тоді ми чекаємо саме на тебе!

Звучить цікаво? Далі більше 💛

Що ти будеш робити:

  • Будувати, підтримувати та оптимізувати CI/CD pipelines для веб-продуктів, сайтів та внутрішніх сервісів компанії у Jenkins та GitLab CI/CD;
  • Підтримувати поступову міграцію deployment processes з Jenkins на GitLab CI;
  • Забезпечувати стабільні, repeatable та predictable deployments з rollback-механізмами і мінімальною кількістю manual steps;
  • Налаштовувати та підтримувати Docker-based runtime environments для web applications та сервісів;
  • Стандартизувати Docker, docker-compose, deployment scripts та runtime-конфігурації, щоб рішення не потребували регулярного rework;
  • Адмініструвати Linux-сервери у production-середовищі: налаштування, patch management, troubleshooting, performance analysis;
  • Автоматизовувати infrastructure setup, configuration management та maintenance-процеси через Ansible і Bash;
  • Підтримувати web infrastructure: Nginx, SSL/TLS, reverse proxy, routing, Cloudflare, DNS, caching та базові security rules;
  • Налаштовувати, підтримувати та покращувати monitoring, logging та alerting для production systems;
  • Аналізувати deployment failures та production incidents, визначати root cause і пропонувати preventive actions;
  • Підтримувати backup/restore, monitoring та базове troubleshooting для MySQL/PostgreSQL;
  • Забезпечення reliability та stability production systems;
  • Аналіз production incidents, проведення root cause analysis та впровадження preventive actions;
  • Участь у post-incident reviews та підготовка технічних висновків після інцидентів;
  • Впроваджувати та підтримувати security practices для Linux і web infrastructure: hardening, контроль доступів, оновлення, закриття вразливостей;
  • Документувати інфраструктурні рішення, deployment workflows, конфігурації та важливі зміни;
  • Узгоджувати production changes з командою, попереджати про ризики та не вносити критичні зміни без прозорої комунікації;
  • Проактивно виявляти слабкі місця в deployment, infrastructure та application architecture, які можуть призвести до нестабільності, та ініціювати їх усунення.

Важливо та потрібно:

  • 3+ роки досвіду адміністрування Linux-серверів у production-середовищі (systemd, networking, firewall, SSH, логування, storage, processes, performance troubleshooting);
  • Впевнене розуміння мережевих технологій і протоколів (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, WebSockets, reverse proxy, routing, діагностика мережевих проблем);
  • Практичний досвід роботи з Docker та docker-compose (runtime-середовища, networking, volumes, дебаг, оптимізація);
  • Досвід побудови та підтримки CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD), включно з автоматизованим деплоєм, rollback та мінімізацією downtime;
  • Досвід автоматизації інфраструктури та конфігурацій (Ansible);
  • Досвід роботи з Nginx (reverse proxy, SSL, routing, деплой веб-застосунків);
  • Розуміння принципів SRE: reliability, observability, incident response, root cause analysis;
  • Досвід роботи з моніторингом та логуванням (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Promtail, Sentry або аналоги) та побудови alerting-стратегій;
  • Базовий/середній досвід адміністрування MySQL/PostgreSQL (backup/restore, моніторинг, troubleshooting);
  • Розуміння best practices безпеки Linux та веб-інфраструктури (hardening, access control, SSL/TLS, patching, vulnerability handling);
  • Сильні навички troubleshooting: локалізація проблем, root cause analysis, preventive actions;
  • Самостійність та ownership у роботі з інфраструктурними задачами end-to-end;
  • Англійська мова на рівні Intermediate (В1) та вище.

Буде перевагою:

  • Досвід роботи з AWS, GCP або іншими хмарними платформами;
  • Досвід роботи з Cloudflare та Terraform;
  • Підтримка великої кількості production-хостів і модернізація legacy infrastructure;
  • Розуміння high-availability рішень (Keepalived, replication, failover);
  • Досвід роботи з Redis, RabbitMQ, Memcached;
  • Розуміння MySQL/PostgreSQL replication;
  • Базові навички Python або Go;
  • Досвід адміністрування WordPress/headless WordPress;
  • Досвід проведення post-incident reviews та RCA.

Чому класно бути частиною нашої команди:

  • Надання послуг у бізнес-години;
  • Унікальні артпростори в Києві на ст. м. Васильківська (відчуй атмосферу! ) або можливість співпраці у віддаленому форматі;
  • Комунікація, заснована на довірі, та відсутність трекерів активності;
  • Гармонія між проєктною завантаженістю та особистим часом, а також – внутрішня медична політика;
  • Креативна спільнота і культура, орієнтована на людей та взаємний фідбек;
  • Привабливі винагороди за запрошення друзів;
  • Конкурентна компенсація в USD;
  • Оплачуваний онбординг і доступ до корпоративної бібліотеки.

*Пункти, перелічені в цьому розділі, можуть відрізнятися залежно від умов вашого договору. Певні пільги та умови зазвичай застосовуються до працівників; незалежні підрядники можуть не мати права на всі ці пільги. Конкретні умови, включаючи компенсацію, пільги та умови співпраці, будуть чітко визначені у вашому договорі, якщо його буде підписано.

Можеш дізнатися більше про компанію та культуру, відвідавши офіційний сайт SupportYourApp та її соціальні сторінки Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn.

Якщо тобі цікаві інфраструктура, автоматизація та стабільна робота систем, а також подобається розбиратися в інцидентах і покращувати надійність сервісів — будемо раді твоєму резюме.

Маєш ідеального кандидата на прикметі? Рекомендуй друга та отримуй винагороду!

jobs.description:
was wir suchen

Jedes Unternehmen braucht laufend neue Kunden – und genau dieses Problem lösen wir. Mit Interlead bauen wir die #1 Plattform für Leads, Termine und Aufträge und machen die Kundengewinnung für unsere Partner damit einfacher, transparenter und planbarer.

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir daher einen DevSecOps Engineer (m/w/d)für unser IT Team, zu 100 % aus dem Home-Office (Deutschland) oder bei uns im Bremer Office!

das sind deine aufgaben

  • Du überwachst und betreust unsere Server

  • Du kümmerst dich um das interne Monitoring

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Weiterentwicklung und Wartung der IT-Infrastruktur

  • Du verwaltest unsere Infrastruktur als Code (z. B. mit Terraform, Ansible)

  • Du integrierst Security-Checks direkt in unsere CI/CD-Pipelines (Shift-Left-Ansatz) und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter

  • Du führst regelmäßige Schwachstellen-Scans und Penetrationstests durch

  • Du kümmerst dich um das Secrets-Management und die sichere Verwaltung von Zugangsdaten

  • Du sorgst für die Einhaltung von Sicherheitsstandards und Compliance-Vorgaben (z. B. ISO 27001, DSGVO)

  • Du betreibst Threat Modeling und bewertest Sicherheitsrisiken frühzeitig

  • Du dokumentierst Prozesse und Infrastruktur

  • Du beobachtest aktuelle Trends und bringst neue Tools und Best Practices ein

  • Du berätst Kolleg:innen bei sicherheitsrelevanten Fragestellungen

dank deiner expertise erreichst du folgende meilensteine bei uns

  • 0-3 Monate:

    • Du hast unser Team, unsere Prozesse und unsere IT-Infrastruktur kennengelernt

    • Du hast dich in unsere bestehende Server-, Monitoring- und CI/CD-Landschaft eingearbeitet

    • Du hast einen Überblick über unsere aktuellen Sicherheitsmaßnahmen und erste Optimierungspotenziale identifiziert

    • Du übernimmst eigenständig erste Aufgaben im Tagesbetrieb und Monitoring

  • 4-6 Monate:

    • Du hast erste Security-Checks in unsere CI/CD-Pipelines integriert (Shift-Left)

    • Du hast Verbesserungen im Monitoring und Alerting umgesetzt

    • Du hast bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Infrastruktur aktiv mitgewirkt

    • Du hast erste Schwachstellen-Scans durchgeführt und Maßnahmen abgeleitet

  • 7-12 Monate:

    • Du verantwortest eigenständig zentrale Teile unserer IT-Infrastruktur

    • Du hast Sicherheitsstandards und Best Practices im Team etabliert

    • Du treibst die Automatisierung von Prozessen eigenverantwortlich voran

    • Du bist zentrale:r Ansprechpartner:in für sicherheitsrelevante Fragestellungen

    • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer DevSecOps-Kultur aktiv mit

das bringst du mit

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im IT-Bereich (z. B. Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik) – oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung

  • Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in der Administration von Linux-Servern

  • Du bist vertraut mit Container-Technologien (Docker, Kubernetes) und deren sicherem Betrieb

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code-Tools (z. B. Terraform, Ansible)

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Du hast Kenntnisse in Monitoring- und Logging-Tools (z. B. Prometheus, Grafana, ELK-Stack)

  • Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für Netzwerke, Firewalls und gängige Sicherheitskonzepte mit

das bieten wir dir

  • Diese Stelle kann zu 100% im Home Office (aus Deutschland) erledigt werden.

  • Du arbeitest in einem erfahrenem Senior-Team, das schnell, lean und ohne unnötige Bürokratie agiert.

  • Wir setzen konsequent auf modernste Technologien und geben dir den Freiraum, Neues auszuprobieren.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien – deine Ideen landen nicht in der Schublade, sondern direkt in der Umsetzung.

  • Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung und gestaltest aktiv mit.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich an Ergebnissen orientieren – nicht an Anwesenheit.

  • Mitarbeit an spannenden, technologisch anspruchsvollen Projekten

  • Moderne Hardware deiner Wahl

das sind unsere werte

  • Fail Fast: Wir leben eine ausgeprägte Testing- und Fehlerkultur. Wir sind pragmatisch, mutig und fühlen uns mit Veränderung wohl.
  • Ergebnisse: Wir arbeiten flexibel, aber verlässlich. Bei uns steht Freiheit in Einklang mit Ergebnisorientierung und Eigenverantwortung.
  • Vertrauen: Wir gehen offen mit Zahlen, Stärken und Schwächen um und machen das, was für die Firma richtig ist ("Ego zurück").

🚀 About VELZI AI

At VELZI AI, we’re redefining finance for the modern business. Our mission is to eliminate manual accounting through advanced AI automation. From procurement to real-time financial reporting, our intelligent SaaS platform streamlines every operational workflow, so companies can focus on growth, not spreadsheets.

We’re a fast-growing, AI-driven fintech startup backed by innovation and a clear, ambitious vision. Now, we’re searching for a DevOps Engineer to help us scale our infrastructure, ensure reliability, and power our next generation of AI-driven financial systems.

💼 About the Role

As a DevOps Engineer at VELZI AI, you’ll build, maintain, and scale a secure, cloud-native infrastructure across GCP, Azure, and AWS. You’ll work closely with our engineering team to ensure seamless deployment pipelines, reliable environments, and high-performance systems that support our AI and fintech applications.

You’ll be the backbone of our infrastructure and enabling fast iteration, smooth deployments, and resilient architectures.

Tasks

🔧 What You’ll Do

☁️ Cloud Infrastructure & Systems

  • Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure across GCP, Azure, and AWS
  • Manage and optimize compute environments including Virtual Machines, Cloud Run, and container orchestration platforms
  • Architect scalable, multi-region solutions with high availability, redundancy, and strong security practices

🐳 Containers, Orchestration & Scaling

  • Conduct root-cause analysis, implement fixes, and prevent future incidents

  • Understanding of API architecture, microservices, and distributed systems

  • Experience with Terraform, Pulumi, or other infrastructure-as-code tools

  • You’re a problem-solver who thrives in fast-moving environments

  • You’re comfortable owning systems end-to-end and improving processes proactively

jobs.description:
Core Values
At RCH, our Core Values are more than just words—they represent the threads that weave together the fabric of our culture. Used as a guide when interviewing new team members; as a barometer when evaluating our performance as individuals and teams, and even when deciding which customers to work with, RCH’s Values embody the behaviors upon which we measure our success and create a framework for our growth as people and professionals.
Our Core Values:
  • Embrace Excellence: We strive for best-in-class delivery of innovation and service.
  • Be Accountable: Integrity, ownership and accountability are non-negotiables.
  • Adventure Together: We are committed to fostering a culture that embraces continuous improvement.
  • Succeed as a Team: We believe harnessing the power of a team drives outcomes not achievable by individuals.
  • Boundaries and Balance: Work-life balance is a core facet of our culture.
If you share in our core values, then we encourage you to continue reading this posting as you may have found a great home for your career.

Job Description
RCH Solutions is seeking a DevOps Engineer with strong backend development skills who will be instrumental in the continued investment in discovery research. We are currently seeking an outstanding engineer with proven experience building secure, well-governed services and the cloud infrastructure that runs them. Using a broad range of backend engineering, infrastructure-as-code, and cloud security methods, the successful individual will continue to evolve growing initiatives for data access, platform reliability, and secure delivery to enable the scientific community.

The successful candidate will own both sides of the platform: the TypeScript/Node.js services that expose governed access to scientific and analytical data, and the GCP infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and security posture that support them. Expertise in access control design, relational data modeling, Terraform, and cloud observability is highly desired.

Role and Responsibilities

Backend
    • Design, build, and maintain backend services in TypeScript and Node.js
    • Design and implement role-based access control (RBAC) across applications and data layers
    • Model and evolve relational schemas using Prisma or a comparable ORM, including migrations
    • Implement and govern BigQuery access patterns at row, dataset, and table level
    • Build well-documented, typed APIs consumed by front-end and data science teams
    • Apply AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, etc.) within established guardrails to accelerate delivery without compromising code quality
DevOps / Platform
    • Build and maintain GCP infrastructure: Cloud Run, Artifact Registry, Cloud SQL, IAM, and VPC Service Controls
    • Define and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform
    • Own CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions covering build, test, and deploy
    • Manage security posture: Dependabot triage, dependency and vulnerability remediation, and secrets management
    • Containerize services with Docker and maintain reproducible build and release processes
    • Implement observability, logging, and monitoring using Cloud Monitoring and related tooling
    • Participate in code review, architecture discussions, and incident response
Essential Requirements
  • Strong professional backend development experience in TypeScript and Node.js
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing role-based access control (RBAC)
  • Relational schema design and migration experience with Prisma or a similar ORM
  • Practical BigQuery experience, including access patterns at row, dataset, or table level
  • Production experience with GCP infrastructure: Cloud Run, Artifact Registry, Cloud SQL, and IAM
  • Infrastructure as code with Terraform
  • CI/CD pipeline ownership in GitHub Actions (build, test, deploy)
  • Dependency and vulnerability remediation, including Dependabot triage and secrets management
  • Docker containerization in a production environment
  • Observability, logging, and monitoring practices using Cloud Monitoring or equivalent
  • Practical experience using AI coding tools (Copilot, Claude, etc.) in a professional setting
  • Ability to work independently in a distributed team on a UK or US East Coast schedule
Minimum Qualifications
  • BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience
  • 2–7 years of professional software engineering or platform engineering experience
  • Strong JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals, including asynchronous patterns and typed API contracts
  • SQL proficiency sufficient to design schemas and reason about query performance
  • Working knowledge of networking, identity, and cloud security fundamentals
  • Proficiency with Git and modern code review workflows
  • Collaborator across a diverse set of groups, including non-technical scientific stakeholders
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Multitasking: balancing a diverse set of projects and deadlines
  • Curiosity and excitement about technology
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with VPC Service Controls or comparable data exfiltration and perimeter controls
  • Experience implementing data governance or audit requirements in a regulated environment
  • Experience with BigQuery cost management and access-pattern optimization
  • Exposure to scientific data platforms (biological, chemical, clinical, or similar)
  • Experience defining SLOs, alerting strategy, or on-call practices
  • Track record of success contributing to and advancing discovery programs
Additional Information
Great talent should benefit from a great work environment. If you join our team, you’ll have access to:
  • A competitive salary and bonus package based on experience
  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, including Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Company-provided Life and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Company-sponsored 401(k) Plan
  • Company-provided continuing education benefit
  • Team-focused culture and unlimited opportunity for advancement
** NOTE: This role is 100% remote and the candidate must be able to work on an East Coast US schedule.

** Candidates must not require sponsorship now or in the future.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Senior DevOps EngineerInfoTrustWe're making our first dedicated investment in DevOps at InfoTrust, and we're looking for the person who will build that discipline from the ground up.
jobs.description:
Senior DevOps Engineer

InfoTrust

We're making our first dedicated investment in DevOps at InfoTrust, and we're looking for the person who will build that discipline from the ground up. Today, deployment, reliability, cloud infrastructure, and security are shared across our experienced engineering teams alongside their product work. As our founding DevOps hire, you'll bring that work together under a single owner and a clear standard defining what great DevOps looks like at InfoTrust, hands-on, with no playbook to inherit and no team to lean on. If you want a finished playbook handed to you, this isn't the role. If you want to be the person who writes it, this is a great opportunity.

About InfoTrust

InfoTrust is a global, privately-owned products and solutions company dedicated to unlocking the power of data to drive marketing performance and business growth. We specialize in digital analytics, media enablement, and privacy-centric solutions that help Fortune 100–500 companies and the world's largest brands optimize their marketing strategies. Our culture is built on passion, ownership, diversity, trust, respect, and continuous growth, values that have earned us multiple “Best Places to Work” awards, including a Great Place to Work certification 7 years in a row and recognition as the #1 place to work in Ohio.

What You'll Own as Senior DevOps Engineer:

  • Reliability & Incident Response – Own the health of our production systems. Define what reliability means for each product, build the observability to catch issues early, and establish incident response – ownership, escalation, and on-call – so outages are rare, short, and well understood.
  • Delivery & Automation – Own how code moves safely and repeatably to production. Build the CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and release automation that let teams ship quickly without sacrificing stability.
  • Cloud Infrastructure & Cost – Own our cloud footprint across AWS and Google Cloud. Contribute to the architecture, capacity, and cost decisions that keep our products performant as they scale, and manage cloud spend deliberately.
  • Data Reliability & Operations – Own the reliability of our data layer. Keep production databases reliable and performant, ensure backups are automated and validated through real restores, and make schema and data migrations routine – executed without downtime or data loss.
  • Security & Compliance – Own the security posture of our infrastructure. Strengthen our cloud environments, partner with our external penetration-testing provider on ongoing security work, and serve as R&D's technical point person for SOC 2, implementing and maintaining the controls that fall to our team while Legal leads the broader compliance program.

You Could Be a Great Fit for the Senior DevOps Engineer Role If:

  • You have 5+ years in DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including having built or substantially matured a function – ideally as a founding or early DevOps hire, or as the person who brought order to an environment that didn't have it yet.
  • You have deep AWS experience, plus solid working knowledge of Google Cloud, and you've owned production infrastructure, networking, and cost in AWS at a senior level.
  • You have CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code mastery – you've built deployment pipelines and codified infrastructure that teams actually adopt, and you can bring standards where there are none.
  • You have production reliability and incident ownership experience – you've owned uptime, built observability, and been the person responsible when something breaks.
  • You have database and data-layer operations experience – owning production database reliability, automated and tested backups, and schema/data migrations executed without downtime or data loss.
  • You have hands-on cloud security experience – identity and access management (IAM), secrets management, and vulnerability remediation – and you've worked with compliance frameworks like SOC 2.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and do your best work in semi-structured environments where you get to impose the structure, rather than being paralyzed by a lack of instruction.
  • You want to build a function, not maintain one, and you'd rather own the whole surface – reliability, delivery, cloud, data, and security – than a narrow slice of one of them.

Bonus Points If:

  • You have experience in MarTech, analytics, or data-infrastructure companies, or with large-scale data pipelines.

You Shouldn't Apply If:

  • You want a finished playbook on day one – you'll be writing it, often while things are still moving underneath you.
  • You expect a specialist's narrow lane – this is a broad role, and reliability, delivery, cloud, data, and security all sit with you.
  • You'd rather security be someone else's job.
  • You prefer big-company process and consensus over making good calls with imperfect information and limited existing structure.
  • You'd rather specialize in a single cloud than operate fluently across AWS and Google Cloud.

Logistics

Reports To: Engineering leadership on the R&D team

Scope: A hands-on individual-contributor role. You'll define the function and do the work – there is no existing DevOps team to inherit, and no direct reports to manage

On-Call: As our founding DevOps hire, you'll participate directly in the on-call rotation, including the one you design and improve. As the function grows, on-call is shared across the team

Partners With: Our external penetration-testing provider on ongoing security work, and the Legal-led SOC 2 program as R&D's technical point person

Autonomy: High. You'll operate with a broad mandate and room to set direction where structure doesn't exist yet

Why Work Here?

At InfoTrust, team members are deeply connected to our core values and have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact every day. Our Core Values are:

  • Earn Trust: Deliver on what you promise.
  • Be Respectful: Don't be an ahole.
  • Promote Diversity: Seek understanding and be inclusive.
  • Take Ownership: There is no “they.” Take initiative.
  • Grow Every Day: Learn and apply.
  • Contribute With Passion: Desire to do good. Give to grow.

Through the InfoTrust Foundation, a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit, we actively give back to the communities where our team members live and work.

Benefits & Equal Opportunity

Benefits include, but are not limited to: health, vision, and dental insurance, unlimited PTO, a generous parental leave program, a 401(k) plan with company match, tuition reimbursement, and much more.

Diversity is one of our six core values at InfoTrust. InfoTrust is committed to a diverse workforce and is an equal opportunity employer. We aim to hire strong, diverse teams built from different backgrounds, experiences, and identities. We are building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career.

Job descriptions are not perfect, and we know you may not check every single box. Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. Don't let that stand in your way – if you are excited about this role, please apply!

jobs.description:
Senior AI Interaction Evaluator (Codex / Claude Code)

Contract | $100–$200/hour | 10–20 hrs/week | Start ASAP (through early May)

Check out this Loom video for more details!

We’re looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role.

You won’t be writing production code.

You’ll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What This Role Actually Is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios — focusing on:

  • Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste — not syntax correctness.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end-to-end

  • Judge whether outputs are:

    • Useful

    • Correct (at a high level)

    • Aligned with how a strong engineer would think

  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just code

  • Distinguish between different levels of response quality (e.g. what makes something a 2 vs 4)

  • Provide clear, opinionated feedback on:

    • What worked

    • What didn’t

    • What felt “off” or misleading

  • Help define what great looks like when interacting with tools like Cursor

What We Mean by “Taste”

We’re specifically looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments.

Who You Are

  • Staff / Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

  • Strong background in one of the below:

    • TypeScript / JavaScript

    • Python

  • Hands-on experience using:

    • OpenAI Codex

    • Claude Code

    • Cursor

  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

  • Able to evaluate code without needing to fully execute or deeply review every line

  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

  • High bar for what “good engineering” looks like

Nice to Have

  • Experience with tools like Cursor or similar AI-first IDEs

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement Details

  • Rate: $100–$200/hour

  • Hours: ~10–20 hours/week

  • Duration: Through early May (with possible extension)

  • Start: ASAP

  • Process:

    • Take-home evaluation exercise

    • One behavioral interview

jobs.description:
Senior AI Interaction Evaluator (Codex / Claude Code)

Contract | $100–$200/hour | 10–20 hrs/week | Start ASAP (through early May)

Check out this Loom video for more details!

We’re looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role.

You won’t be writing production code.

You’ll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What This Role Actually Is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios — focusing on:

  • Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste — not syntax correctness.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end-to-end

  • Judge whether outputs are:

    • Useful

    • Correct (at a high level)

    • Aligned with how a strong engineer would think

  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just code

  • Distinguish between different levels of response quality (e.g. what makes something a 2 vs 4)

  • Provide clear, opinionated feedback on:

    • What worked

    • What didn’t

    • What felt “off” or misleading

  • Help define what great looks like when interacting with tools like Cursor

What We Mean by “Taste”

We’re specifically looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments.

Who You Are

  • Staff / Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

  • Strong background in one of the below:

    • TypeScript / JavaScript

    • Python

  • Hands-on experience using:

    • OpenAI Codex

    • Claude Code

    • Cursor

  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

  • Able to evaluate code without needing to fully execute or deeply review every line

  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

  • High bar for what “good engineering” looks like

Nice to Have

  • Experience with tools like Cursor or similar AI-first IDEs

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement Details

  • Rate: $100–$200/hour

  • Hours: ~10–20 hours/week

  • Duration: Through early May (with possible extension)

  • Start: ASAP

  • Process:

    • Take-home evaluation exercise

    • One behavioral interview
